reviews.text:
I just took my dog to Rivergate Clinic for the first time and WOW, I’m so glad I did! After moving to the neighborhood, I had tried a different clinic and I felt like that wasn’t the right place for us to take our dog.

After getting two recommendations from neighbors for Rivergate Clinic, I decided to give it a try, and I’m so glad I did! Dr. Peter Kross is absolutely outstanding, and the staff are friendly and welcoming. You can really tell they care about their patients and their owners. 10/10!

Great office, big fan of the staff here except dr Sadeghi might just decide to skip your appointment on a whim. I was ten-fifteen minutes late for my appt at 12:30pm. The patients after me were scheduled for 1pm and were also ten minutes late. Dr sadeghi seems to not care if your dog is shaking from anxiety shedding off half her coat in the waiting room, and wanted her to suffer for 30 extra minutes. All just so that she could see other patients, that were also ten minutes late, that I arrived way before. I won’t be booking with her again.
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We certainly appreciate your trust. We're here to deliver quality veterinary care whenever you need us.
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We certainly appreciate your trust. We're here to deliver quality veterinary care whenever you need us.

If I could give zeros stars I would. Thank you SO much for wasting my afternoon Rivergate! This was my first time here and I waited nearly 40 minutes for my dog to be seen while the entire time he laid on the floor shaking from anxiety. I asked not once but twice to see how much longer only to be met with an attitude by the two receptionists. My sincere apologies for asking you to do your job. The best part was when they let another patient in ahead of me that was there after me.
After my poor dog started crying and continuously shaking, I got up to leave, only to be met with “ok we’ll reschedule you.” No apologies. No nothing.
Please don’t bother rescheduling people who you clearly are able to neglect for 40 minutes. We won’t be back
Dr Cavanagh is the best vet my animals have ever seen. He’s caring, knowledgeable and delicious.  He handles my animals like no other.

We have been seeing Dr. Eve for the past three years with our cat Ziti and would recommend her to anyone! She is kind, thorough and very patient. She is also great with communication and will call personally to discuss test results and treatment plans. We feel so lucky to have found Rivergate and Dr. Eve!

This is the best vet in NYC. Dr. Kross and his team are exceptional and will do everything to provide the best service to your pet. We have been going for years and are so grateful for their help and kindness. A special mention to Leo for his fantastic service and knowledge in case you need travel documents for your pet. Thank you 🙏 …

Kind, honest, careful, straightforward.
My experience here was full of ease, organized, and just honestly left me feeling a great deal of comfort.
My neighbor recommended me to this doggie doctor to me, and it’s easy to see why. I feel so much better knowing that I found a great vet in NYC.

I arrived around 9:45 a.m. to schedule an appointment for 10:30 a.m. I came back at 10:20 a.m. and waited, assuming that since I had a 10:30 appointment, someone would call my name.

When no one called me, I went to the front desk around 10:45 a.m. and told them I was still waiting. I was told, "They'll call you within two minutes."

By 11:07 a.m., I was still waiting while other patients were being called in and out. When I asked the receptionist again, I was told that I had arrived late. That is simply not true—I was there at 10:20 a.m. They could have checked me in while I was waiting at 10:30.

Then I was told, *i"I don't know what time they'll be able to see you."Even if I had actually arrived late for some reason, was I expected to wait indefinitely without anyone telling me? If that was the case, why was I told that I would be called in within two minutes?

This experience was extremely disappointing, and I will not be returning.
